newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Interceramic rated buy. [CORRECTED 16:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Interceramic rated buy. [CORRECTED 16:45 GMT]

text.p: Interceramic ICM.N was reinitiated as a buy after previously being rated hold by Flemings Research, the brokerage said in a statement Friday.

"We feel that concerns over the company's debt level have been overdone. Operating cash flow will help it (corrects from "help the market") meet its obligations in 1997," analyst Dan McGoey told Reuters.
-- "Interceramic's FY96 results were strong, with a sharp rebound in the operating margin from -1.6 percent in 1995 to 6.8 percent in 1996," the brokerage wrote.
-- The company's margins improved as its new plant in Garland, Texas, reached full capacity and despite pressure on domestic tile prices, it said.
-- "Interceramic's share price may provide a 'stand-out' valuation opportunity in the heady Mexican stock market," the brokerage wrote.
-- The company's Mexican shares closed trading Friday at 12.50 pesos each.
